title: ChatGPT or A Silent Everywhere Helper: A Survey of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying existing literature and benchmark datasets (e.g., StereoSet, BBQ, Winobias, CrowS-Pairs) used to evaluate stereotypes, prejudices, and unequal portrayals of minority and vulnerable demographic groups in language models.

Reviewing empirical studies that test LLMs on generating story endings, revealing that models consistently produce positive outcomes even when instructed to be neutral, reflecting majority preferences or societal norms.
